title: Roasted Irish Vegetables Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with roasted Irish vegetables, perfect for a cozy evening.
instructions: Toss the sweet potatoes, carrots, and parsnips with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large pot, sauté the onions and garlic until softened.
Add the cooked lentils, roasted vegetables, and vegetable broth to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Season with your favorite herbs and spices.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
